reviews.x: Very easy to use. I’m a first timer but I also know how to make anything work in my favor.  I only issue you may have is making smaller lines. It can be done it’s about the squeeze on the bottle.  IMPORTANT, if you want it to last long you leave the dried henna on overnight . Instructions says 1 hour. The longer , the darker  the stain.

I bought this wanting to do the henna freckles trend and wasn’t very pleased. I put all the henna on like it said and when I took it off you couldn’t even tell I had done anything. I waited the 24 hours it said to for it to darken and I still couldn’t see a change.
The dye did not work at all.  It may be old but there is no way of telling the date that it was made.

i waited so long to get this. i’m so disappointed. this did absolutely NOTHING. i would love my money back. i tried so many henna kits and i’ve never tried one this terrible. i’m so very dissatisfied and sad with this product. what a waste of money. don’t try this. i’ve used henna on 9 different people and the results came back the same- it did absolutely nothing. so disappointed.
Waste of money here! The ink doesn’t stay even if you keep it for hours and use a big amount. I finished one entire bottle for just a tiny tattoo and that didn’t work...
Easy to use and looks great when done. Week 1 done with no fading. I love it and will buy again!

This is the second or third time I bought this kit but this time it didn't work at all. It left a stain so faint it can't be seen. I left the paste on for two hours and was very disappointed this time to see hardy anything. I think I probably got a bad batch.
Works just like the real thing. I ordered my kids another box each!
Didn't work at all left on for double the time and didn't even color the skin at all differently want buy it again
Great product. Easy to use and easy instructions

[[VIDEOID:63100e5e5e3e5775a72f3a351c0c0122]] The henna is not even staining the skin. I allowed the henna to dry completely. Rubbed off the henna after it was dry and nothing was there. I’m so disappointed. The last day of school and we had a party. I thought it would be cool to do henna with the kids. We are so disappointed. Don’t waste your money.

reviews.t: It does not last at all and is very light even right when it is taken off
reviews.x: Although the directions say to leave it on for 30 mins, I left it on all night to make it darker, but even when I left it on all night it didn't work. Just get a normal henna tube and don't waste your money with this one. It also smells bad. The only good thing is the stencils.

Did not stain at all. Very disappointing. If you buy this you’ll just be drawing on your skin for it to flake off in 30 minutes. Waste of money and you’ll come out better just using a pen to draw on your skin. Please don’t buy.

[[VIDEOID:a48d0672f24484251dd348a61f8fd257]] Its a little hards to manage in the little tubes. It didn’t stain for my skin. Dont wast your money.. sad thing is you cant even get your money back. Waste of money.

reviews.t: Barely visible ink that does not last 24 hours
reviews.x: After applying ink and leaving on for over an hour, the designs could be faintly seen on skin. They never darkened in the following days, just disappeared. I can’t recommend as it really didn’t work.

1. I LOVE the tips. Helps control flow of product and you can do very detailed lines easily. 2. I love how there are stencils so, if you can't freehand, you can just stencil.  Now on to the bad. This DOESNT work. I could NOT for the life of me, get it to stain, which I ended up googling and all the results show that it could be that the product is old. An expiration date on this product would be nice.  I tried multiple times to get it to work and failed every time, so I am gonna assume the produ

So I read everything online. And when it was delivered, I followed the directions. It's easy to use and do freestyle. But when you take it off, there's nothing left. You're supposed to wash it off and it'll have stained and will stay like that for 3-6 days. And it didn't even show at all after I washed it off. And bottles are super small. It would've been nice if it would've stained. But clearly didn't. Even after leaving it on for nearly 2 hours.

This was after I had left the product on for about an hour. I did remove it with water because it hurt otherwise, I would not waste money on this. For a couple dollars more you can get much better quality and the consistency of the product is liquidy and hard to control in small details.

Don't buy this product. Tried this on myself and my daughter (we are both very pale skinned people) and it didn't leave any pigment behind at all. Left it on for several hours the first time, overnight the second time and it left nothing. This is a waste of money.

None of the bottles were the same consistency. One was extremely runny and one was really thick. None of them left a lasting mark. Either it was so faded immediately after setting that you couldn’t see it, or it flaked off after drying. Not impressed at all.

First of all the dispensing nozzle on one of the pieces was broken so the henna couldn’t be used to make any designs. Secondly, the henna did not stain the skin at all! I left it on for the time specified, but not even the faintest of color showed up.

I'm really sad this didn't work out. I've gotten henna done before but I've never done it myself. So I follow the instructions and even lookup some videos. It just didn't take. I don't know I may have gotten a bad bach but I was very disappointed. 😔

It showed up, immediately, so that was my first red flag that this wasn't Jagua... this is probably henna, or something.  Jagua either doesn't show up, immediately, or is very faint, initially, before getting darker blue-black. VERY disappointed.

The henna does not work at all. I left it on for over 4 hours and when i removed the residue, nothing was left. Not even a dot.  Amazon doesn’t allow returns on henna, so they’re selling a faulty product and stealing money... gross.

reviews.t: Not worth your money or time. Horrible product
reviews.x: Horrible stuff do not purchase. Been on for over two hours and all it did was flake like in the picture. Doesn’t even stain like henna ink does. I cant get my money back or return due to covid so I’m livid.

claims.text: Many reviewers report the henna does not stain or darken the skin at all, even when left on longer than instructed.
Several reviewers call the product a waste of money and express strong disappointment.
Some reviewers find it easy to use with clear instructions and good value.
A few reviewers note the results are faint or fade quickly, with one suspecting a bad batch.
Some reviewers praise the results, saying it looks great and works like real henna.
